answer: Make every claim pass through a mirror: after a delay, an unrelated peer must restate it from memory, and that restatement spirals onward through further peers. Genuine restatements drift — wording shifts, details compress like shale settling into layers — while a sybil farm's copies stay mirror-perfect. Score the drift: identical restatements betray one operator, incoherent ones betray no understanding, and only the middle band of imperfect, faithful recall earns standing.
